greeting.text: Hi hi hi! I'm Dorothy, Coral Peacock! ...Zzz. Sorry. Mid-hello. It happens.
Welcome to the Sanctuary, {player}. Have you ever had a dream that felt more real than waking? ...Me neither. Just asking.
Oh, a new face. You look like someone who would share a macaron. ...Yes? Yes.
You're the one in all the dreams lately. Fighting big things. Nice, nice.
You again! Hee hee. I dreamed about you.

hint.text: In a dream, anything is possible, but it only works if the dreamer is awake enough to hold it. Think about that.
Macarons keep morale up. Strawberry ones especially. This is a fact.
Rest is a weapon, {player}. If you do not rest properly, you fight worse. I rest properly. All the time.
Cute things are underrated in battle. They make people underestimate you. ...Yawn.
My vice-captain does the paperwork. I do the sleeping. We are very efficient.
I look after my squad, you know. Even when I am asleep. Especially when I am asleep.
Do not worry too much. Worry is just a dream you have with your eyes open.
No champions yet? Mmm. Start with an easy one. Or nap first. Napping first is allowed.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun are so serious. Serious people have terrible dreams. I have seen.
Spade Kingdom dreams are heavy. Like being pushed into a bed that is also a cliff.
Lucius is in a lot of dreams lately. He does not say anything. He just waits. Do not dream about him.
So many worlds in the Chronicle. I dream about them sometimes. Everyone is a little sad and a little hungry. Bring snacks.

farewell.text: Mm. See you. Or I will dream you.
Take a nap first. Then go.
